prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished desktop website design comp, 1536x1024 landscape: a real web layout, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The attached reference images are screenshots of the SAME website's already-built pages. Carry over exactly: the header (script wordmark "Birdcar" at left; nav "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing" and a canary-yellow pill "Book a free Walkthrough →"), the pale daylight ground #edf3f0, near-black ink #0b141a, the heavy tight grotesk (Mona Sans) for all text, white cards with soft offset shadows, white pill tags, canary yellow #f7c848 only on actions and small highlights, and the premium matte isometric miniature render style. Do NOT copy any reference's page content beyond what this prompt names.

This page is "Eight ways work gets stuck": a free field guide from Nick (Birdcar). It names the eight patterns he uses in his Walkthrough reports so an owner can recognize their own week, then book a free Walkthrough. The eight pattern names, exactly: 1 "It runs on remembering", 2 "The same information, typed twice", 3 "Nobody trusts the numbers", 4 "Assembled by hand", 5 "Waiting on a reply", 6 "Only one person knows how", 7 "Waiting on your yes", 8 "The workaround became the process". The visitor's job: recognize a few, read those entries, book a Walkthrough.

STRUCTURE, in reading order (check what you recognize: an interactive self-check):
1. Header, about 80px, as the reference.
2. Upper band (y 110 to 330): at left, headline about 64px over two lines: "Eight ways work gets stuck. Most businesses have a few." At right, aligned to the headline, a lead at about 20px: "Tick what sounds like your week. The patterns behind it rise to the top."
3. Main band (y 360 to 960), two panels side by side:
LEFT panel (x 80 to 820), a large white card with a 14px radius: the title "Sound familiar?" and a wrapping cloud of pill-shaped check chips, each with a small check circle, reading exactly: "Sticky notes as a to-do list", "I just know to…", "Copy and paste between tabs", "I update it in both places", "A spreadsheet kept open just in case", "It takes an afternoon to pull together", "Just following up on…", "Ask Dana", "Approvals pile up when you're busy", "It has a name: the Monday sheet". Three chips are selected: solid ink with white text and a canary check.
RIGHT panel (x 860 to 1460): a ranked list titled "Your likely patterns", eight rows, each with the pattern number in a small circle, the exact pattern name, and a thin horizontal meter; the top three rows ("Waiting on your yes", "It runs on remembering", "The same information, typed twice") have canary-yellow meters partly filled, the rest are empty gray. Under the list, the canary-yellow button "Bring these to a free Walkthrough →".
4. Bottom band (y 980 to 1024): the top of the next section, heading "1  It runs on remembering".

ART DIRECTION: one dominant move, the self-check; no illustration is needed except a tiny canary perched on the top edge of the left card. Premium, adult, precise. Not cute, not gamified, no scores or percentages. No purple, no gradient orbs, no robots, no AI imagery, no stock photos, no testimonials. Preserve all quoted words exactly. Treat it as a finished, shippable website.
